title: 第11章 赌斗规则第12章 千钧桩
content_zh:
正午，b区食堂。
红色的警示灯光下，空气中弥漫着一股浓烈霸道的油脂香气，与a区那种冷淡的工业合成味截然不同。
江岳端着那只特制的合金大碗，找了个角落坐下。
碗中便是他用全部身家——15点积分换来的【黑甲鳞牛碎肉汤】。
汤色赤红如血，表面漂浮着一层厚重的金色油脂。
虽然名为碎肉，但每一块肉丁都切得四方齐整，在滚烫的汤汁中翻滚，散发着令人晕眩的高能热量。
周围几张桌子上，几名凑钱“拼单”尝鲜的新兵正小心翼翼地喝着。
他们每喝一口，都要闭目停顿许久，甚至有人面色涨红，显然是虚不受补，正在艰难地引导气血消化。
江岳没有犹豫。
他端起大碗，仰头，如同吞咽烈酒一般，将滚烫的肉汤连同那些坚硬的碎骨渣，大口灌入喉咙。
“咕咚。”
热流顺着食道冲入胃囊，仿佛吞下了一团燃烧的炭火。
视网膜边缘，沉寂已久的面板瞬间高亮。
【行为：进食】
【状态：高能物质摄入！】
【当前词条：化食（白色）——超负荷运转中。】
【描述：胃囊蠕动频率提升300%。正在剥离黑甲鳞牛血肉中的狂暴精气……转化开始。】
江岳只觉得腹中传来一阵如雷鸣般的闷响。
若是常人如此暴饮暴食，此刻恐怕早已胃出血。
但在【化食】词条的霸道碾压下，那些足以撑裂普通人血管的能量，被强行粉碎揉烂。

一股股精纯得近乎实质的热流，如岩浆般冲出胃袋，疯狂地灌入他那干瘪许久的四肢百骸。
原本因为长期营养不良而有些灰败的皮肤，此刻以肉眼可见的速度泛起健康的红润，甚至隐隐透着一层油光。
十分钟。
仅仅十分钟，江岳放下空空如也的大碗。连汤底的骨髓渣都被他嚼碎咽了下去。
【化食】进度条暴涨了一大截。
他站起身，感觉浑身的毛孔都在向外喷吐着灼热的白气。
这种久旱逢甘霖的充盈感，让他甚至有一种想要仰天长啸的冲动。
……
深夜，凌晨两点。
蜂巢营房早已熄灯，此起彼伏的呼噜声响成一片。
江岳躺在胶囊舱内，双眼紧闭。
【安神】词条正在尽职尽责地试图让他的大脑进入深度睡眠。
然而，这一次，他的身体却在躁动。
那碗黑甲鳞牛汤的能量太足了。
对于他这具尚未完全长开的身体来说，这就是过量的养分。
滚烫的气血在血管里横冲直撞，如果不发泄出去，淤积的热毒反而会烧坏脏腑。
“睡不着。”
江岳猛地睁开眼，翻身坐起。
他轻手轻脚地打开舱门，犹如一只灵巧的夜猫，避开了巡逻的机械守卫，摸向了浮陆边缘。
五分钟后。

第十七号浮陆，g4废弃甲板区。
这里正对着巨大的通风口，寒冷的星际罡风呼啸而入，足以冻僵普通人的血液。
content_en:
Noon, canteen in Area B.
Under the red warning light, the air was filled with a strong and overbearing aroma of oil, which was completely different from the cold industrial synthetic smell in Area A.
Jiang Yue took the special alloy bowl and found a corner to sit down.
In the bowl was the [Black-armored Beef Minced Broth] that he had exchanged for all his wealth - 15 points.
The soup was as red as blood, with a thick layer of golden grease floating on the surface.
Although it is called minced meat, each piece of meat is neatly cut into squares and tumbling in the hot soup, exuding dizzying high-energy heat.
On several tables around, a few new recruits who had pooled their money to try something new were drinking cautiously.
Every time they took a sip, they would close their eyes and pause for a long time, and some even turned red. It was obvious that they were weak and struggling to guide their energy and blood to digest.
Jiang Yue did not hesitate.
He picked up the big bowl, raised his head, and poured the hot broth together with the hard bone fragments into his throat as if he were swallowing strong liquor.
"Gudong."
The heat rushes down the esophagus and into the stomach, as if swallowing a ball of burning coals.
At the edge of the retina, the panel that had been silent for a long time suddenly became highlighted.
[Behavior: Eating]
[Status: High-energy substance intake! 】
[Current entry: Huashi (white) - operating at overload. 】
[Description: The frequency of gastric pouch peristalsis increases by 300%. The violent essence in the flesh and blood of the black-armored ox is being peeled off...the transformation begins. 】
Jiang Yue felt a muffled sound like thunder in his stomach.
If ordinary people were to overeat like this, they would probably have stomach bleeding by now.
But under the overbearing crushing of the [Transformation of Food] entry, the energy that could burst the blood vessels of ordinary people was forcibly crushed and crushed.
Wave after wave of pure and almost substantial heat rushed out of his stomach like magma, pouring crazily into his long-dried limbs.
The skin that was originally a bit gray due to long-term malnutrition now turned healthy and rosy at a speed visible to the naked eye, and even had a faint sheen.
Ten minutes.
In just ten minutes, Jiang Yue put down the empty bowl. Even the bone marrow residue in the soup base was chewed up and swallowed by him.
[Transformation of Food] The progress bar has skyrocketed.
He stood up, feeling that hot white air was spitting out from the pores all over his body.
This feeling of fullness after a long drought made him even have the urge to look up to the sky and scream.
…
Late at night, two in the morning.
The lights in the Beehive Barracks have long been turned off, and the sound of snoring can be heard one after another.
Jiang Yue lay in the capsule cabin with his eyes closed tightly.
[Soothing the Mind] Entry is dutifully trying to put his brain into deep sleep.
However, this time, his body was restless.
That bowl of black-scaled beef soup is too powerful.
For his body that has not yet fully grown, this is an excess of nutrients.
The hot Qi and blood are rushing in the blood vessels. If it is not vented, the accumulated heat and poison will burn the internal organs.
"Can't sleep."
Jiang Yue opened his eyes suddenly and turned over to sit up.
He opened the hatch softly, like a nimble night owl, avoiding the patrolling mechanical guards, and reached the edge of the floating land.
Five minutes later.
No. 17 Floating Land, G4 abandoned deck area.
This place is facing a huge vent, and the cold interstellar wind roars in, enough to freeze the blood of ordinary people.
